nodes.label: verify-dapp Verification Skill
nodes.rationale: Ordered fail-fast verification (contract tests, build, lint, live RPC read) so any change to contract/, src/, or config is checked end-to-end; stops at first failure to keep reports actionable.

nodes.label: Live Soroban RPC Read Check (get_campaign_count simulation)
nodes.rationale: Simulating a get_campaign_count call against soroban-testnet.stellar.org confirms the frontend's read path still works against the deployed contract without needing a wallet or a signed transaction.
nodes.norm_label: live soroban rpc read check (get_campaign_count simulation)

nodes.label: Manual Wallet-Flow Testing Requirement
nodes.rationale: Wallet-dependent flows (connect, signing, contribute, withdraw/refund) cannot be verified headlessly because wallets are browser extensions; changes to src/lib/soroban.ts, src/lib/wallet.ts, or src/components/Campaign.tsx require manual browser testing on Testnet.

nodes.label: Stellar Frontend Challenge (Level 1 - White Belt) Submission
nodes.rationale: The project is the user's challenge submission; the README's screenshot checklist must stay intact for submission, and Stellar-specific concepts should be briefly explained to the user (new to Stellar, fluent in web3 and React/TypeScript).

nodes.label: Watchdog (lease balance monitor)
nodes.rationale: Checks active leases for balance exhaustion every METER_INTERVAL_MS instead of per-tick billing, trading worst-case one-tick over-use for avoiding a per-tick debit hot path.

nodes.label: Custodial top-up/payout model
nodes.rationale: Top-ups pool at PLATFORM_PAYTO and balances are an off-chain ledger in Neon; contributor earnings are settled on-chain at lease end via PLATFORM_PRIVATE_KEY, but there is no on-chain renter withdrawal path yet for unused balance.

nodes.label: In-memory nodes/leases
nodes.rationale: Deliberate: keeps Postgres out of the heartbeat/watchdog hot path. A registry restart drops live sessions; for HA this state must be persisted and externalized.

nodes.label: Bill-once, prorated billing model
nodes.rationale: Usage is calculated continuously but charged once at lease end, prorated at the hourly rate, instead of per-tick debits; watchdog polling interval bounds worst-case over-use to one tick.

nodes.label: Trust model (ephemeral Docker sandbox boundary)
nodes.rationale: The safety boundary isn't a permissions system but an ephemeral, mount-less, capability-dropped Docker container destroyed at lease end — the same containerization trade-off the DePIN compute sector already runs on, made prepaid and individual-scale.

nodes.label: Vite SPA choice for web/
nodes.rationale: web/ deliberately uses Vite instead of Next.js because the wallet stack is client-only, so a plain SPA avoids SSR/hydration friction.

nodes.label: Web app not dockerized note
nodes.rationale: The web app is a static Vite SPA on purpose, so it is intentionally excluded from docker-compose and instead built with `npm run build -w web` and hosted statically.
